title: Payload #15116: TypeError Cannot read private member #headers on Node.js 24

error_signal.message: payload TypeError: Cannot read private member #headers from an object whose class did not declare it in isolateObjectProperty when proxying request headers on Node 24

ground_truth.root_cause_description: Node 24 undici uses private class fields for headers. isolateObjectProperty creates a proxy that cannot access private #headers field.
ground_truth.fix_description: Fix proxy handler to properly delegate private field access
